assumptions_not_claimed_as_rtl_calibrati: Cache stage timing, insertion-LFSR phase, and pipeline stage latencies are abstractions that require cycle-by-cycle calibration.

The L1D controller's priority omits probes, atomics, maintenance and the credited read turn's exact edges; the SQ launch interval, the C-to-U interval (coherence_release_cycles), and the L2 home's lookup and fill timing are abstractions, and the home's instruction prefetch table and DMA pause are not modeled.

The default DDR endpoint models FROST's single-channel axi_behavioral_memory.sv (LATENCY=80, NUM_SLOTS=max(L2MaxSlots,8)); board DDR4 MIG refresh and bank/row timing require hardware or VIP trace calibration.
Workload micro-ops are representative pressure patterns, not captured Redis, HTTP, Linux or FaaS execution traces.
The model does not execute the RISC-V ISA, model Sv39 page walks/DMA coherence traffic as workload events, or prove functional RTL equivalence.
The candidate sweep may rank sensitivities, but synthesis/Fmax/area and RTL waveform comparison are required before an RTL change is accepted.
implemented_features: Explicit CpuTopModel + SocTopModel separation across the 6-bit-ID, 512-bit AXI4 boundary so downstream projects can replace SocTopModel or DdrController independently.

Two-wide dispatch/retire, bounded ROB/RS/LQ/SQ with MEM_RS release at issue and LQ release at the result, out-of-order load/ALU completion, two-lane CDB contention, and committed stores draining from the SQ into the L1D's store records.
Load Queue L0 Data Cache (256 dword entries) with 1-cycle CDB fast-path bypass and fill from L1D memory responses.

Coherent L1D with one controller, request endpoints held through U, attached loads that look up again after installation, stream look-ahead on the highest endpoints, four ordered store records with one lent endpoint, and buffered victim writebacks.
Separate L1I and L1D caches; 32-byte to 64-byte sector adapter; L2 with the home's stream prefetch agent; fill ownership; coalescing; writeback slots; write intent; cache-line dirty state.

Explicit cache lower transaction IDs ({type, slot}), 64-byte single-beat AXI transfers, soc_axi_slave physical address decode (DDR vs. local BRAM/MMIO), and a single-channel 512-bit AXI DDR model matching axi_behavioral_memory.sv.
Deterministic workload generators, sweep driver, self-tests, and machine-readable bottleneck counters.

source_proven_facts.fact: Platform composition splits cpu_top and soc_top across a single 6-bit-ID, 512-bit (64B) AXI4 master/slave boundary.
Two-wide dispatch and commit; 32-entry ROB; 8-entry load and store queues; explicit RS capacities (16 INT RS, 8 MEM RS); 4-bundle decoded queue.
Production cache parameters in cpu_top are L1I 16 KiB, L1D 128 KiB, L2 2 MiB, four ways, L1D MSHR 8, L2 MSHR 4, L2 WB 2, L2 waiters 2, prefetch enabled.
L1 lines are 32 bytes; L2 and DDR-facing AXI lines are 64 bytes/512 bits; AXI transactions are single beat.
Cache MSHRs reserve their victim way until fill and downstream IDs encode {type,slot}; L1D uses four-bit IDs and L2 uses five-bit IDs (DdrAxiIdBits=5).
A line-size adapter maps 32-byte L1 sectors into 64-byte L2 lines; L2 supports bounded MSHR waiters and stream prefetching.

soc_axi_slave routes physical DDR addresses [0x8000_0000, +DdrCapacityBytes) to a single 5-bit-ID, 512-bit DDR AXI port (backed in simulation by axi_behavioral_memory with latency=80, NUM_SLOTS=max(L2MaxSlots,8), optional LFSR jitter and reorder) and routes low BRAM/MMIO to a single local port.
Load Queue direct-mapped L0 Data Cache (NormalLqL0Depth = 512 dword entries) provides 1-cycle fast-path bypass for cached hits; EARLY_LOAD_WAKEUP enables 1-cycle dependent scheduling.

At ade0de67, cpu_top passes L1D_NUM_MSHR=8 request endpoints, L2_NUM_MSHR=8 home fills, L2_PREFETCH=1, L2_PREFETCH_DISTANCE=8 and L2_PREFETCH_INFLIGHT=3; the model's default keeps four L2 miss slots, and a board configuration states eight.

MEM_RS frees an entry when it issues, and the LQ frees an entry when cdb_stage captures its result; an ordinary store marks its ROB entry done at issue, commits, and keeps its SQ entry until the L1D acknowledges its launch.
Cached stores launch from the SQ one at a time: a launch waits for the previous write's done and the L1D's record credit, and the L1D acknowledges a captured store on the next cycle.

The coherent L1D buffers committed stores in four ordered 32-byte records; only the youngest unsealed record combines, a record seals at 32 contributors or when the head is selected, and every record installs at the head. Endpoint 0 carries the head's GetM and at most one load endpoint is lent to a younger record's GetM.

One L1D controller serves one operation at a time in Idle priority order (probe, grant, SC, atomic write, head store, lookahead store, read, maintenance, stream hint). A lookup passes Idle, Lookup, the array's tag read (1 cycle) and its reply; a hit adds the 2-cycle data read, an acquisition its Acquire cycle, and an installation or store update its Update, 1-cycle array write and UpdateWait.

Load misses take the lowest free load endpoint; a miss on a sector that a live endpoint holds attaches and looks up again after the installation; a demand grant answers its load in its Lookup cycle; each endpoint stays live through U.

Stream look-ahead: three adjacent demand sector misses confirm a stream; the cursor stays within eight sectors past the frontier and within a 4 KiB page; hints use the highest PrefetchCount load endpoints (2 with four or more endpoints, 1 with three), demand may use every load endpoint, and a hint is the controller's lowest-priority selection.

The home's prefetch agent trains a four-stream table on accepted hart GetS and GetM, L2 hits included; it confirms on two consecutive lines, requests up to eight lines ahead within the page, loads a request only while more than FILLS/4 fills are free, holds each of three identities from D through U, and the home fills only with two available ways and, for a valid victim, two free writeback slots.
